item.title: TikTok removes over 580,000 videos in Kenya as moderation scrutiny grows
item.description: TikTok removed more than 580,000 videos in Kenya between July and September 2025 for violating its content rules, according to the company’s latest enforcement data.

item.title: Kenya’s Arc Ride secures $5 million IFC commitment for regional expansion
item.description: The company’s backing from the IFC comes ahead of its planned Series A round, which the startup plans to use for its regional expansion.

item.title: Africa’s loyalty programmes are siloed. This Ghana-based startup wants to unify them
item.description: Points Africa is building what it describes as Sub-Saharan Africa’s first shared loyalty network, a system that allows multiple merchants to issue and redeem a single reward currency to its users.

item.title: Telecoms foreign investment rebounds to its highest level since 2019
item.description: Foreign direct investment (FDI) into Nigeria’s telecommunications sector is rebounding, driven by improved pricing reforms, naira stability, and renewed investor confidence.

item.title: Cash, M-PESA, or cards? Kenyan banks test a new payments strategy in schools
item.description: Kenyan banks are targeting students with prepaid cards, turning schools into testing ground for a long term race to win future customers.

item.title: Nigeria rules out new standalone crypto law for now
item.description: Nigeria will not rush into passing a new law to govern virtual assets, marking a shift from expectations that Africa’s largest crypto market would move swiftly toward case-by-case legislation.

item.title: MTN moves to take full control of IHS Towers in $2.2 billion deal
item.description: MTN Group, Africa’s largest telecom operator, is moving to take full ownership of IHS Towers in a $2.2 billion deal that would consolidate control of nearly 29,000 telecom towers across Africa.

item.title: Nigeria to conduct “thorough assessment” of MTN’s $2.2 billion IHS deal
item.description: Nigeria's Ministry of Communications, Innovation, and Digital Economy will review MTN Group's proposed $2.2 billion acquisition of IHS Towers
